items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I don't think -- I saw Barney is on it I think -- Barney McCarthy.

ctx.x: Yes, I know that. He and Bobby Hackett on the same bill. I don't know for sure if I'm going to be on it. I expected to be on it but if that's the way they want it that's their thing, you know. Ain't nothing to me.
Yeah. I don't think -- I saw Barney is on it I think -- Barney McCarthy. But I don't know whether that's everybody or just a few names --
Yeah, I don't know. I haven't heard anything though. The only thing I know that I'm going to Nice or supposedly. So I just don't know.
-- Vic Dickenson, yes, another one. And he brought back -- who's the girl singer who used to be with Benny Goodman? The blonde girl?
